start: ^Am I an expert in your laws, Judean? Your priests drag this man to my praetorium at dawn and expect me to sign a death warrant for words.
^They say he claims to be a king. If he is a king without an army, he is a fool. If he has an army, let him show his banners.
^What is truth to a man holding three legions?

s: ^Does Roman law allow execution without clear sedition?
